title: Migration drift — migrations replay to the committed schema
notes: Only runs when SHADOW_DATABASE_URL is set to a database dedicated to being replayed and diffed by `prisma migrate diff --from-migrations`. It deliberately does NOT reuse DATABASE_URL / the shared hermetic Postgres other suites and CI jobs depend on — replaying the full migration history into a shadow database is destructive to whatever that database currently holds. Skips cleanly (value 0, details.skipped) when SHADOW_DATABASE_URL is absent, same as any other unmet `requires`.
